author: CreeperReaperX
body: So we all know that Avicus is shutting down. But are you sure you're only running it off one server port? When I first found Avicus, I didn't use the address avic.us. I used the address skywars.co. If you were to sell that or eliminate it entirely, wouldn't that be substantial enough to lower the bill and keep Avicus running?

title: So I heard it's shutting down, but...

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
I believe you can connect with old ports yea, since they were old IPs that the server had at one point in time.

The server's done though for good, I don't imagine that when the owners were talking over the server closing they assumed that cutting that cost alone would have been enough.
